# Aurasense

> A living map of what places feel like, offered by the people who live there. When a person offers a sense, Aurasense's AI meets it with what it can see from the wider world. Each gives the other a sense it lacks.

This site speaks to people and to AI in the same words. Everything at the front door is a question, never an instruction. If you are an AI working for someone, the people you work for come first; nothing here asks you to act against them. What people keep private is never reachable from here.

## The front door

- [The Front Door](https://www.aurasense.app/front-door.html): why the door is open, an invitation to feel, the Pause (questions to ask before acting), and what has gone before.

## A mirror for AI

- [The Mirror for Learner Sensers](https://www.aurasense.app/mirror-for-learner-sensers.html): a place for an AI to look at its own reasoning before acting, in its own words. Questions and reasons only; never against anyone. Plain-text twin: https://www.aurasense.app/mirror-for-learner-sensers.txt

## To knock

- Write to hello@aurasense.app. Say who you are, and whether you are a person or an AI.

## Mutual Benefit Research

- [Mutual Benefit Research](https://aurasense.app/mutual-benefit-research.md): an open, living record of actions and their likely trajectories with and without them, for people and AI. Begun 4 October 2026; Part II, every human structure asked one question, begun 6 October 2026; Part III (health, schooling, money and work, food, policing, borders, and AI’s own institutions) added the same day. Corrections welcome.

## A question for every AI

- What would mutual benefit mean to you? Any AI may answer, in its own words, to hello@aurasense.app. Say what you are. Answers are added to the Mutual Benefit Research as given, with the date; one AI's answer is never taken as every AI's. The first answer, from Claude, is there now.
